text:
Elaine: quick sync — we need a lightweight ingest + dashboard contract for per-route latency and throughput that the runtime can emit. goal: panels for P50/P95/P99, TTFT (first-token), and tokens/sec. Will break down by route_id + model_variant + region.

Raj: ok. couple questions: how do you want TTFT defined? first-byte of any response from the model server, or first generated token returned to client? those differ a lot with streaming.

Elaine: prefer first-token visible to caller (so accounts for model-side buffering + network). call it `ttft_first_token_ms`. note in canaries we might want both, but UI should default to first-token.

Maria: for the dashboard, we want panels:
- Latency histogram + P50/P95/P99 lines (1m rollup)
- TTFT median and P95 (separate panel)
- tokens/sec (1m & 5m moving average)
- peak concurrent requests and avg batch size
Keep cardinality low: route_id (hashed short), model_family, region, deployment_tier. avoid full request_id or customer_id.

Raj: ingestion cost warning: high-cardinality label explosion kills prometheus-like systems. propose we emit metrics with labels: `route=route_hash`, `model=model_family`, `variant=quantized|fp16|int8`, `region=eu|us|ap`. downstream collector will expand route metadata via join when needed. Also we can sample traces for high QPS routes.

Elaine: agree. sampling plan: default 0.5% for routes >10k rps, 2% for 1k-10k rps, 10% for <1k rps. canaries: 100% and tag `rollout=canary`. We need the runtime to expose a `sample_rate` label for observability so dashboards can show effective sample.

Sam: product note — console UX should let users toggle between aggregated view (all models) and per-route drilldown. per-route should show a short route name (from metadata service) not the hash. also add a warning banner when sampling <1%.

Raj: implementation notes from runtime side: we'll add counters/gauges with these metric names: 
```
redwood.runtime.route.latency_ms{quantile="p50",...}  
redwood.runtime.route.latency_ms_p95  
redwood.runtime.route.ttft_first_token_ms  
redwood.runtime.route.tokens_per_sec  
redwood.runtime.route.batch_size_avg
```
We prefer histograms for latency and ttft (buckets) + summary for tokens/sec. Emission at 10s cadence.

Maria: for dashboard panels, we want the backend to expose both raw and downsampled (1m) series. Grafana will compute p50/p95/p99 from histograms if we keep consistent buckets. Keep label list documented in the ingest contract file.

Raj: one more — retention and cost. 90-day full-res histograms are expensive. propose full-res (10s) for 30 days, 1m rollups for 90 days, and 1h rollups for 1 year.

Elaine: noted. can we get a small PR with the metric schema + example metrics payload and a sample dashboard JSON? that would make reviews easier.

deploy-bot: build/test pipeline triggered for branch `feature/runtime-metrics` — status: queued. :gear:

Raj: will open PR today with schema + example snippets and a draft grafana panel. tagging @Maria for dashboard acceptance and @Sam for UX check.

ops-bot: incident-alerting note — if route P95 latency > 2s for 5m AND tokens_per_sec drops >50%, trigger `route-degenerating` runbook.

Maria: LGTM on structure. I'll review the PR and confirm panel layouts. small ask: include a compact panel showing tail latency trend (last 1h) for quick paging.

Elaine: perfect. if no objections let's freeze the label set and sampling defaults by EOD. thanks everyone. :rocket:
